I. 1. 47</ls>; as ह of letters, Revatī of asterisms, Mīna of the zodiacal signs. <ab>&c.</ab>; अन्त्ये वयसि in old age <ls>R. 9. 79</ls>; अन्त्यम् ऋणम् <ls>R. 1. 71</ls> last debt; ˚मण्डनम् <ls n="R.">8. 71</ls> last funeral decoration, <ls>Ku. 4. 22</ls>. .²2 Immediately following (in <ab>comp.</ab>); अष्टम˚ ninth. .²3 perishable, transitory; देहाद्यपार्थमसदन्यमभिज्ञमात्रं (विन्देत) <ls>Bhāg. 12. 8. 44</ls>. .²4 Lowest (in rank, degree or position), undermost, worst, inferior, base, vile, wretched; ˚अवस्थां गतः <ls>Pt. 4. 110</ls> reduced to the worst plight; अन्त्यासु दशासु <ls>Pt. 1. 336</ls> at perilous (critical) times; belonging to the lowest caste; चण्डाल ˚स्त्रियः <ls>Ms. 11. 175</ls>; ˚स्त्रीनिषेविणः <ls n="Ms.">12. 59</ls>; अन्त्यादपि वरं रत्नं स्त्रीरत्नं दुष्कुलादपि; शूद्राश्च सन्तः शूद्राणामन्त्यानामन्त्ययोनयः (साक्ष्यं कुर्युः) <ls n="Ms.">8. 68</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">3. 9</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">4. 79</ls>; <ls>Y. 1. 148</ls>, <ls n="Y.">2. 294</ls>. .{@-न्त्यः@} .²1 A man of the lowest caste; see above. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of a plant (मुस्ता <lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>नागरमोथा</ns>) ({%f.%} also) (the roots of which are prescribed for colic). .²3 The last syllable of a word. .²4 The last lunar month <ab>i. e.</ab> Phālguna. .²5 A Mlechcha, foreigner, barbarian. अन्त्येषु स विनिक्षिप्य पुत्रान् यदुपुरोगमान् <ls>Mb. 1. 86. 12</ls>. .²6 (In Vaiśeṣika <ab>Phil.</ab>) A name for the category विशेष; अन्त्यो नित्यद्रव्यवृत्तिर्विशेषः परिकीर्तितः <ls>Bhāṣā P.</ls> .{@-न्त्या@} .²1 A technical name for त्रिज्या in astronomy. .²2 A woman of the lowest tribe. .{@-न्त्यम्@} .²1 A measure of number; 1000 trillions (1000,000,000,000,000). .²2 The 12th sign of the zodiac. .²3 The last member or term of a progression (series), the last figure; स्थाप्योन्तवर्गो द्विगुणान्त्यनिघ्नः <ls>Līlā.</ls>
